speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. My wife brought you here due to your bizarre and agitated behavior; can you tell me exactly what you have been experiencing and how long it has been happening?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. His wife adds that he has been increasingly withdrawn and intermittently depressed over the last 3 months. He was terminated from his job 4 weeks ago after he ceased attending work. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizophrenia

Based on your 6-week history of paranoid delusions regarding the NSA controlling your mind and your withdrawal from work and social life, these are classic signs of a psychotic disorder. To confirm the diagnosis and rule out medical causes like thyroid issues or substance use, I need to order some blood work and a urine drug screen.
